macros.name: doclicenseFullText
macros.doc: \doclicenseFullText Pretty prints the full license text.

macros.name: doclicenseFullTextFileName
macros.doc: \doclicenseFullTextFileName Expands to the file name which the \doclicenseFullText macro uses to \input the license text file.

macros.name: doclicenseIcon
macros.doc: \doclicenseIcon Expands to an icon of the license.

macros.name: doclicenseImage
macros.doc: \doclicenseImage This is kind of similar to \doclicenseIcon but it will typeset an bigger pictogram of the license.

macros.name: doclicenseLongName
macros.doc: \doclicenseLongName Expands to the long name of the license.

macros.name: doclicenseLongNameRef
macros.doc: \doclicenseLongNameRef Same as \doclicenseLongName except that it links to the URL of the license.

macros.name: doclicenseLongText
macros.doc: \doclicenseLongText Same as \doclicenseText except that it uses the long name of the license.

macros.name: doclicenseLongTextForHyperref
macros.doc: Same as \doclicenseLongText except that it does not contain \href and other complex macros. The purpose of this macro is to be used as value inside of \hypersetup.

macros.name: doclicenseLongType
macros.doc: \doclicenseLongType Same as \doclicenseType except that it expands to the long license type.

macros.name: doclicenseModifier
macros.doc: \doclicenseModifier Expands to the modifier as set in the package options.

macros.name: doclicensePlainFullText
macros.doc: \doclicensePlainFullText Verbatim prints the full license text.

macros.name: doclicensePlainFullTextFileName
macros.doc: \doclicensePlainFullTextFileName Expands to the file name which the \doclicensePlainFullTextFileName macro uses to \verbatiminput the license text file.

macros.name: doclicenseType
macros.doc: \doclicenseType Expands to the type as set in the package options.

macros.name: doclicenseTypeIcon
macros.doc: \doclicenseTypeIcon Expands to an icon of the license type.

macros.name: doclicenseURL
macros.doc: \doclicenseURL Expands to the official URL about the license.

macros.name: doclicenseVersion
macros.doc: \doclicenseVersion Expands to the version as set in the package options.
